baseline.value: Non-availability of innovative and real-time national WASH information management systems and platforms for enhanced sector monitoring, evaluation and learning

target.value: 2027:Functional and sustainable WASH sector MEAL mechanism with clear knowledge management strategy that supports innovative and real-time monitoring and evaluation and learning.

actual.value: 2025:Existing National Sanitation Management Information System in place and is being upgraded to include harminized safely managed indicators

title.narrative: Existence of water, sanitation and hygiene sector capacity development mechanism , Text

baseline.value: Unidentified national and sub-national capacity gaps in the WASH sector that impact sector development.

target.value: 2027:Functional and sustainable WASH sector capacities with clear policy and institutional frameworks for sector development available in target regions of mainland and Zanzibar.

actual.value: 2025:Capacity development mechanisms put oin place for government, LGA personnel and stakeholders. Personnel are supported to attend internal conferences and workshops, learning visits to other countries, plan for trainig WASH private sector partners.
